incident-bot: SEV2 detected in eu-west control plane — elevated request timeouts. Automatic action: HOLD scheduled change windows for affected regions. Deploybot paused any active canaries.
jenna (release-manager): on it. which windows are affected? also tagging @sam for SRE input.
sam (sre): eu-west only so far, impact on control plane API < 20% but timeout spike correlated with deploy traffic. recommend abort canary and hold other zones until we confirm root cause.
olivia (release_engineer): confirmed canary abort in progress. I see one DB migration step queued in the canary batch — can we skip that step and still release non-db patches?
diego (backend): that migration is additive (index add). it touched the control plane metrics path in the migration hook — prefer to hold migration. non-db binaries are safe.
jenna (release-manager): proposal: split the rollout. 1) cancel migration from this cycle, 2) release non-db changes in a reduced canary once control plane stabilized, 3) schedule migration for next maintenance window after SRE thumbs-up. agree? :thinking_face:
sam (sre): +1 to split. we need a deterministic rollback path if things regress. can we pin the currently-deployed image as the rollback target?
olivia (release_engineer): will pin current image as fallback. pin id: img-20260314-9f2a. also updating canary steps to skip migration.
jenna (release-manager): I'll update release notes and the changelog to mark migration deferred. Mina, please check product comms for customers on the next-monday migration window.
mina (product): ack — will draft a short note and queue it for legal review.
jenna (release-manager): ops command to requeue and annotate — using deploybot: ```
# requeue release without migration
/deploybot requeue --release v2026.03.4 --remove-step "db:add-index" --annot "split_release:incident_hold_euw" --new-window "2026-03-22T23:00:00Z"
```
olivia (release_engineer): ran dry-run, looks good. will push the requeue when SRE gives final green for reduced canary.
sam (sre): running controlled checks now (control-plane CPU, grpc latency trace). ETA 12m. if stable, give thumbs-up for reduced canary only (no migration).
deploy-bot: automated update — release v2026.03.4 paused by incident hold. canary jobs aborted: job-6792. Rollback target pinned: img-20260314-9f2a. Pending manual requeue per @jenna.
jenna (release-manager): owners: @sam for infra sign-off, @olivia for deploy changes, @mina for customer comms. I'll also file a short postmortem note in #incidents after root cause known.
diego (backend): quick note — add a smoke test for the migration hook in next PR so hooks don't hit control plane metrics hot path.
sam (sre): +1 on smoke test. running validations now — will post results in 10m.
jenna (release-manager): thanks team. once sam posts green we'll execute the requeue command above and update the release tracker. :white_check_mark:
